title: Mario & Luigi: Dream Team
subtitle: A holiday inside Luigi's dreams
summary: Mario & Luigi: Dream Team is AlphaDream's Nintendo 3DS role-playing adventure set on Pi'illo Island, where a holiday becomes a struggle involving Bowser and Antasma. body: Mario & Luigi: Dream Team is AlphaDream's Nintendo 3DS role-playing adventure set on Pi'illo Island, where a holiday becomes a struggle involving Bowser and Antasma. Mario enters Luigi's dreams to help rescue the island's inhabitants, moving between the ordinary world and a side-on dream landscape. The brothers remain linked to separate buttons during their travels, but Luigi's sleeping imagination gives their partnership another form. The setting makes room for a great many Luigis at once, allowing a familiar supporting character to become the source of the adventure's most unusual possibilities.

The touchscreen shows Luigi asleep while the upper display presents the Dream World. Interacting with the sleeper can affect the scene above: provoking a sneeze, for example, produces a gust of wind. Groups of Luiginoids can gather into forms that help Mario overcome obstacles, connecting the dream setting to a series of practical transformations. The controls make the connection visible across the hardware. A small action performed on Luigi below can change the space in which Mario needs to move, turning the two screens into different sides of the same dream.

Battles use turn-based choices with timed button presses to improve attacks or respond to incoming blows. In dreams, Luiginoids support Mario and supply larger Luiginary Attacks, while selected boss encounters turn Dreamy Luigi into a giant. The scale can change dramatically without losing the player's responsibility for the timing of an action. Dream Team extends the series through Luigi's identity rather than only another destination. His expressions, sleep and imagined duplicates provide both the comedy and the tools that make this particular journey possible.
